text:
Sources for the Lexington map pin hold. Bodies verbatim (typographic quotes normalised to straight); salutations and signatures omitted.

1. Email thread "Alpha Lexington" (Gmail thread 1a0d4b73ef31138e), Robbie Forrest, 2026-10-06 08:39 PT, cc Artemis Fletcher:
One remaining Lexington item: please remove the Lexington pin from the interactive locations map <https://map.app.alpha.school/> until the campus is approved. It has been reported as green and "enrolling," which conflicts with the proposed-campus status.

2. trilogy-group/educrm-city-communities PR 236 "fix(NO-TICKET): [ATMC] hold Lexington off the public map pending approval", comment by wseng-nex, 2026-10-07 07:51 PT:
Fernando's call: accept this as a temporary, map-only hold, with a deadline so it doesn't become a silent exception.
- Remove `MAP_PUBLICATION_HOLDS` for Lexington within 15 days, or at the latest revisit it at 30 days (by 2026-11-06) with a permanent HubSpot-driven map-visibility mechanism.
- Reason: anyone seeing Lexington fully set up in HubSpot but missing from the map will otherwise have to guess why.
- Please add a follow-up ticket for the HubSpot-driven mechanism and link it here.
PR 236 approved by fernandopps 2026-10-07 08:26 PT; merged 2026-10-07 08:29 PT (2026-10-07T15:29:07Z).

3. Email thread "Alpha Lexington", Robbie Forrest, 2026-10-07 09:18 PT, cc Artemis Fletcher:
Thanks, Matt. I confirmed Lexington is absent from the live map data feed.

Map-only was intentional for now. Keep the proposed-campus page, Locations card and inquiry path, with the existing under-review / not-open / not-enrolling wording.

Please document the temporary map hold in HubSpot so the exception is visible there. Before changing the broader visibility flag, please confirm which pages, forms and other systems it controls and whether it would remove the inquiry path. We can then choose the right source setting without undoing the approved page changes.
